function: Excluded for function: STAR reconstructs micro-Doppler spectra of human motion from incomplete channel windows for activity sensing (pp. 1, 7), which is not any of the seven areas.
notes: Excluded for function (step 1, rule 5). p. 1: "a neural network that reconstructs micro-Doppler sequences of human movement even from highly incomplete channel measurements"; the output feeds a CNN for activity recognition (p. 12), and the only communication aspect is the overhead of the sensing fields (p. 14). It designs no beams, waveforms or resources (area 5) and does not estimate the communication channel (area 2). Borderline only because the setting is a joint communication and sensing system (IEEE 802.11ay at 60 GHz).
